No source edits or workflow dispatches.

import difflib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

REQUEST_ID = "exec-20260713-issue380-regression-003"
ISSUE_NUMBER = 380
BASELINE_REF = "44fc4a4dc5f8eef78536979decb60377a214e6c2"
BASELINE_SHORT = BASELINE_REF[:7]

RELOCATION_PAIRS = [
    (".github/scripts/chatgpt_apply_in", "tools/chatgpt_apply_in"),
    (".github/scripts/chatgpt_stage_out", "tools/chatgpt_stage_out"),
    (".github/dcoir_review/scripts", "scripts"),
    (".github/dcoir_review/prompts", "prompts"),
    (".github/dcoir_review/schemas", "schemas"),
    (".github/chatgpt_staging", "chatgpt_staging"),
    (".github/github_actions", "project_sources/github_actions"),
    (".github/operator_tools", "operator_tools"),
    (".github/ops", "ops"),
]

SURFACE_PATHS = [
    ".github/workflows",
    ".github/actions",
    ".github/github_actions",
    "project_sources/github_actions",
    "chatgpt_staging",
    ".github/chatgpt_staging",
    "ops",
    ".github/ops",
    "operator_tools",
    ".github/operator_tools",
    "tools",
    ".github/scripts",
    "scripts",
    "prompts",
    "schemas",
    ".github/dcoir_review",
]

repo_env = os.environ.get("ISSUE380_REPO_ROOT") or os.environ.get("DCOIR_REPO_ROOT") or os.getcwd()
REPO = Path(repo_env).resolve()
out_env = os.environ.get("ISSUE380_OUT_DIR")
if out_env:
    OUT = Path(out_env)
else:
    OUT = Path(os.environ.get("DCOIR_DOWNLOADS_DIR", tempfile.gettempdir())) / "issue380-workflow-regression-003"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

results = []
errors = []
facts = {
    "request_id": REQUEST_ID,
    "issue": ISSUE_NUMBER,
    "baseline_ref": BASELINE_REF,
    "repo": str(REPO),
    "output_dir": str(OUT),
}
failed = False


def utc_now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def write_text(path, text):
    Path(path).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def mark_error(message):
    global failed
    failed = True
    errors.append(message)


def run_step(name, args, cwd=None, optional=False, env=None):
    global failed
    cwd_path = Path(cwd or REPO)
    args = [str(item) for item in args]
    log_path = OUT / f"{name}.log"
    started = utc_now()
    stdout = ""
    stderr = ""
    code = 127
    lines = [
        f"# {name}",
        f"started_utc: {started}",
        f"cwd: {cwd_path}",
        "command: " + json.dumps(args),
        "",
    ]
    if not cwd_path.exists():
        stderr = f"Working directory does not exist: {cwd_path}\n"
        lines.extend(["## stderr", stderr])
    else:
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                args,
                cwd=str(cwd_path),
                env=env,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            )
            code = int(completed.returncode)
            stdout = completed.stdout or ""
            stderr = completed.stderr or ""
            if stdout:
                lines.extend(["## stdout", stdout])
            if stderr:
                lines.extend(["## stderr", stderr])
        except Exception:
            code = 126
            stderr = traceback.format_exc()
            lines.extend(["## exception", stderr])
    finished = utc_now()
    lines.extend(["", f"finished_utc: {finished}", f"exit_code: {code}"])
    write_text(log_path, "\n".join(lines))
    results.append({
        "name": name,
        "exit_code": code,
        "optional": bool(optional),
        "log": log_path.name,
        "started_utc": started,
        "finished_utc": finished,
    })
    if code != 0 and not optional:
        failed = True
    return code, stdout, stderr


def read_required_file(path, label):
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.exists():
        mark_error(f"Missing file for {label}: {path}")
        return ""
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def git_show(ref, repo_path, label):
    code, stdout, stderr = run_step(
        "show_" + label.replace(" ", "_").replace("/", "_"),
        ["git", "show", f"{ref}:{repo_path}"],
    )
    if code != 0:
        errors.append(f"git show failed for {label}: {ref}:{repo_path} (exit {code})")
        return ""
    return stdout


def normalize_relocation_text(text):
    value = text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in RELOCATION_PAIRS:
        value = value.replace(old, new)
    return value.strip()


def compare_normalized(name, baseline_text, current_text):
    baseline_normalized = normalize_relocation_text(baseline_text)
    current_normalized = normalize_relocation_text(current_text)
    baseline_path = OUT / f"{name}.baseline.normalized.txt"
    current_path = OUT / f"{name}.current.normalized.txt"
    diff_path = OUT / f"{name}.normalized.diff.txt"
    write_text(baseline_path, baseline_normalized + "\n")
    write_text(current_path, current_normalized + "\n")
    if baseline_normalized == current_normalized:
        write_text(diff_path, "No normalized diff.\n")
        return True
    diff = difflib.unified_diff(
        baseline_normalized.splitlines(),
        current_normalized.splitlines(),
        fromfile=baseline_path.name,
        tofile=current_path.name,
        lineterm="",
    )
    write_text(diff_path, "\n".join(diff) + "\n")
    return False


def write_summary(exit_code):
    summary = {
        "request_id": REQUEST_ID,
        "issue": ISSUE_NUMBER,
        "baseline_ref": BASELINE_REF,
        "request_head_sha": facts.get("request_head_sha"),
        "evaluated_current_ref": facts.get("evaluated_current_ref"),
        "changed_files_in_request_head": facts.get("changed_files_in_request_head", []),
        "baseline_inventory_generation_attempted": facts.get("baseline_inventory_generation_attempted", False),
        "normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity": facts.get("normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity"),
        "normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity": facts.get("normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity"),
        "normalized_contract_parity": facts.get("normalized_contract_parity"),
        "command_results": results,
        "errors": errors,
        "failed_before_summary": bool(failed),
        "exit_code": exit_code,
    }
    write_text(OUT / "issue380-regression-summary.json", json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    md = [
        "# Issue #380 workflow regression evidence",
        "",
        f"- request_id: {REQUEST_ID}",
        f"- baseline_ref: {BASELINE_REF}",
        f"- request_head_sha: {summary['request_head_sha']}",
        f"- evaluated_current_ref: {summary['evaluated_current_ref']}",
        f"- normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity: {summary['normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity']}",
        f"- normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity: {summary['normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity']}",
        f"- normalized_contract_parity: {summary['normalized_contract_parity']}",
        f"- exit_code: {exit_code}",
        "",
        "## Command results",
    ]
    for result in results:
        md.append(f"- {result['name']}: exit {result['exit_code']} optional={result['optional']} -> {result['log']}")
    if errors:
        md.extend(["", "## Errors"])
        md.extend(f"- {item}" for item in errors)
    write_text(OUT / "issue380-regression-summary.md", "\n".join(md) + "\n")


def main():
    global failed
    if not REPO.exists():
        mark_error(f"Repo root does not exist: {REPO}")
    code, request_head, _ = run_step("detect_request_head", ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    request_head = request_head.strip()
    facts["request_head_sha"] = request_head
    current_ref = request_head
    changed_files = []
    if request_head:
        parent_code, parent_stdout, _ = run_step("detect_request_parent", ["git", "rev-parse", f"{request_head}^"], optional=True)
        diff_code, diff_stdout, _ = run_step("detect_request_commit_files", ["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", request_head], optional=True)
        changed_files = [line.strip() for line in diff_stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if parent_code == 0 and len(changed_files) == 1 and changed_files[0].startswith(".github/chatgpt_staging/exec_requests/") and changed_files[0].endswith(".json"):
            current_ref = parent_stdout.strip()
    facts["changed_files_in_request_head"] = changed_files
    facts["evaluated_current_ref"] = current_ref

    work_root = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "dcoir_issue380_exec003_work"
    baseline_worktree = work_root / f"baseline-{BASELINE_SHORT}"
    if baseline_worktree.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(baseline_worktree, ignore_errors=True)
    work_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    run_step("prune_git_worktrees", ["git", "worktree", "prune"], optional=True)

    baseline_inventory_json = OUT / "baseline_generated_workflow_inventory.json"
    baseline_inventory_md = OUT / "baseline_generated_workflow_inventory.md"
    current_inventory_json = OUT / "current_generated_workflow_inventory.json"
    current_inventory_md = OUT / "current_generated_workflow_inventory.md"

    worktree_code, _, _ = run_step("create_baseline_worktree", ["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(baseline_worktree), BASELINE_REF])
    facts["baseline_inventory_generation_attempted"] = worktree_code == 0
    if worktree_code == 0:
        run_step(
            "generate_baseline_inventory",
            [sys.executable, "project_sources/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py", "--json-output", str(baseline_inventory_json), "--markdown-output", str(baseline_inventory_md)],
            cwd=baseline_worktree,
        )
    else:
        errors.append("Baseline worktree was not created; baseline inventory generation skipped.")

    run_step(
        "generate_current_inventory",
        [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py", "--json-output", str(current_inventory_json), "--markdown-output", str(current_inventory_md)],
    )

    baseline_inventory_json_text = read_required_file(baseline_inventory_json, "baseline generated workflow inventory JSON")
    current_inventory_json_text = read_required_file(current_inventory_json, "current generated workflow inventory JSON")
    baseline_inventory_md_text = read_required_file(baseline_inventory_md, "baseline generated workflow inventory Markdown")
    current_inventory_md_text = read_required_file(current_inventory_md, "current generated workflow inventory Markdown")
    baseline_contract_text = git_show(BASELINE_REF, "project_sources/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json", "baseline modularization contracts")
    current_contract_text = git_show(current_ref, ".github/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json", "current modularization contracts")

    facts["normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity"] = compare_normalized("workflow_inventory_json_generated", baseline_inventory_json_text, current_inventory_json_text)
    facts["normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity"] = compare_normalized("workflow_inventory_markdown_generated", baseline_inventory_md_text, current_inventory_md_text)
    facts["normalized_contract_parity"] = compare_normalized("workflow_modularization_contracts_json", baseline_contract_text, current_contract_text)

    code, stdout, stderr = run_step("baseline_to_current_name_status", ["git", "diff", "--name-status", BASELINE_REF, current_ref, "--", *SURFACE_PATHS])
    write_text(OUT / "baseline-to-current-name-status.txt", stdout + ("\n## stderr\n" + stderr if stderr else ""))
    code, stdout, stderr = run_step("baseline_workflow_surfaces", ["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BASELINE_REF, ".github/workflows", ".github/actions", "project_sources/github_actions", "chatgpt_staging", "ops", "operator_tools", "tools", "scripts", "prompts", "schemas"])
    write_text(OUT / "baseline-workflow-surfaces.txt", stdout + ("\n## stderr\n" + stderr if stderr else ""))
    code, stdout, stderr = run_step("current_workflow_surfaces", ["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", current_ref, ".github/workflows", ".github/actions", ".github/github_actions", ".github/chatgpt_staging", ".github/ops", ".github/operator_tools", ".github/scripts", ".github/dcoir_review", "tools", "scripts", "prompts", "schemas"])
    write_text(OUT / "current-workflow-surfaces.txt", stdout + ("\n## stderr\n" + stderr if stderr else ""))

    run_step("check_workflow_action_versions", [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_action_versions.py"])
    run_step("check_workflow_consistency_drift", [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_consistency_drift.py"])
    run_step("build_workflow_inventory_check", [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py", "--check"])
    run_step("check_workflow_modularization_contracts", [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_modularization_contracts.py"])
    run_step("audit_reusable_contracts", [sys.executable, ".github/github_actions/tools/audit_reusable_contracts.py"])

    gh_env = os.environ.copy()
    token = gh_env.get("DCOIR_GITHUB_FG_TOKEN") or gh_env.get("DCOIR_GITHUB_CL_TOKEN")
    if token:
        gh_env["GH_TOKEN"] = token
    run_step("latest_workflow_maintenance_audit_runs", ["gh", "run", "list", "--workflow", "workflow-maintenance-audit.yml", "--branch", "main", "--limit", "5", "--json", "databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url"], optional=True, env=gh_env)
    run_step("latest_scheduled_health_check_runs", ["gh", "run", "list", "--workflow", "scheduled-health-check.yml", "--branch", "main", "--limit", "5", "--json", "databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url"], optional=True, env=gh_env)

    parity_ok = bool(facts.get("normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity")) and bool(facts.get("normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity")) and bool(facts.get("normalized_contract_parity"))
    exit_code = 0 if parity_ok and not failed else 1
    write_summary(exit_code)
    return exit_code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        rc = main()
    except Exception:
        mark_error("Unhandled harness exception: " + traceback.format_exc())
        write_text(OUT / "harness_exception.txt", traceback.format_exc())
        rc = 1
        write_summary(rc)
    sys.exit(rc)
